bibliographic.title: Exploring LLMs for Scientific Information Extraction using the SciEx Framework

relevance_to_mlgg: Most architecturally similar to MLGG. Retrieval-Extraction-Verification closed loop with schema-constrained decoding, provenance tracking (document ID + chunk + figure ref per extracted value), and self-verification triggering re-retrieval for low-confidence fields.
key_methods: Self-verification triggers re-retrieval for uncertain fields
key_findings: GPT-4o outperforms Gemini-2.5-Flash across all datasets
Precision low (0.17-0.33), recall moderate (0.27-0.61) on complex datasets
Cross-sentence reasoning is a major error source
Table extraction error-prone due to structural variability
Numeric interpretation from figures: multiple error sources (axes, scales)
actionable_for_mlgg: Add provenance: store which section/paragraph each extracted value came from
Implement REV loop: low-confidence fields trigger PMC re-retrieval + second extraction
Separate table/figure extraction from text extraction
Schema-constrained decoding already implemented via Pydantic Literal types
